an5.7:1.2: Asitavyābhaṅgiṃ bhikkhave kulaputto ohāya agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti, ‘saddho pabbajito kulaputto' ti alaṃ vacanāya.
an5.7:1.4: Labbhā bhikkhave yobbanena kāmā, te ca kho yādisā vā tādisā vā.
an5.7:1.5: Ye ca bhikkhave hīnā kāmā ye ca majjhimā kāmā, ye ca paṇītā kāmā, sabbe kāmā tveva saṃkhaṃ gacchanti. 3.
an5.7:1.6: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave daharo kumāro mando uttānaseyyako dhātiyā pamādam anvāya kaṭṭhaṃ vā kathalaṃ vā mukhe āhareyya,
an5.7:1.7: tam enaṃ dhātī sīghaṃ sīghaṃ manasikareyya,
an5.7:1.8: sīghaṃ sīghaṃ manasikaritvā sīghaṃ sīghaṃ āhareyya,
an5.7:1.9: no ce sakkuṇeyya sīghaṃ sīghaṃ āharituṃ, vāmena hatthena sīsaṃ pariggahetvā dakkhiṇena hatthena vaṅkaṅgulaṃ karitvā salohitaṃ pi āhareyya.
an5.7:1.13: Karaṇīyañ ca kho evaṃ bhikkhave dhātiyā atthakāmāya hitesiniyā anukampikāya anukampaṃ upādāya.
an5.7:1.14: Yato ca kho bhikkhave so kumāro vuddho hoti alaṃ pañño, anapekkhā dāni bhikkhave dhātī tasmiṃ kumāre hoti
an5.7:1.15: ‘attagutto dāni kumāro nālaṃ pamādāyā' ti. Evam
an5.7:2.1: eva kho bhikkhave yāva kīvañ ca bhikkhuno saddhāya akataṃ hoti kusalesu dhammesu, hiriyā akataṃ hoti kusalesu dhammesu, ottappena akataṃ hoti kusalesu dhammesu, viriyena akataṃ hoti kusalesu dhammesu, paññāya akataṃ hoti kusalesu dhammesu, anurakkhitabbo tāva me so bhikkhave bhikkhu hoti.
an5.7:2.2: Yato ca kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno saddhāya kataṃ hoti kusalesu dhammesu, hiriyā kataṃ hoti kusalesu dhammesu, ottappena kataṃ hoti kusalesu dhammesu, viriyena kataṃ hoti kusalesu dhammesu, paññāya kataṃ hoti kusalesu dhammesu, anapekkho dānāhaṃ bhikkhave tasmiṃ bhikkhusmiṃ homi
